## Pack for {{venture_name}}

```text
{{venture_name}}/
├── {{venture_name}} - main doc     # REQUIRED
├── Capacity/                           # work package
├── Deliverables/                       # work package
├── Dissemination/                      # work package
├── Process/                            # work package
├── Wrapping up/                        # optional
├── Participants / effort log           # optional
├── Accounting/                         # optional
├── Meetings/                           # optional
└── Bibliography / Lit/                 # optional
```

## Main doc outline

About; Structure (core team, partners, roles, governance, how to contribute, workparties); Resources; Development streams; Methodology; Planning; Orientation; Signalization tools.

See `../WorkPackagePlanning.md`.
